REM-SSH-01.objective: Enforce SSHv2 and high-assurance ciphers in PAN-OS
REM-SSH-01.cli_command:
set deviceconfig system ssh ciphers [ aes256-gcm aes128-gcm aes256-ctr ]
set deviceconfig system ssh macs [ hmac-sha2-512 hmac-sha2-256 ]
set deviceconfig system ssh kex [ ecdh-sha2-nistp384 ecdh-sha2-nistp256 ]
commit
REM-SSH-01.after_example: set deviceconfig system ssh ciphers [ aes256-gcm ... ]
REM-SSH-01.rollback_command:
delete deviceconfig system ssh ciphers
commit
REM-SSH-01.explanation: Hardens management plane SSH daemon with modern Elliptic Curve and GCM cipher suites.

commit

REM-SNMP-01.objective: Configure SNMPv3 with authPriv and disable SNMPv2c strings in PAN-OS
REM-SNMP-01.cli_command:
set deviceconfig system snmp-setting version v3 snmp-user secadmin authpwd "AuthPass2026!" privpwd "PrivPass2026!" authproto sha256 privproto aes-256
delete deviceconfig system snmp-setting version v2c
commit
REM-SNMP-01.before_example: set deviceconfig system snmp-setting version v2c snmp-community-string public

REM-SNMP-01.rollback_command:
delete deviceconfig system snmp-setting version v3
commit
REM-SNMP-01.explanation: Replaces insecure v2c community strings with SNMPv3 USM authPriv profile.
